title: OpenAI-assisted capstone user-story refinement
summary: Senior capstone teams first collect and write user stories through stakeholder brainstorming, then use OpenAI models and prompting techniques to refine those stories and discover omitted requirements. Industry experts assess the resulting stories for quality and comprehensiveness.
